name: Peter Whitehead
features: fair skin, dark hair neatly parted, light eyes, long narrow face, slim build, quiet composed expression, cloth helmet and goggles
bio: A Yorkshire wool merchant who bought the first Ferrari sold to a private owner and promptly won the 1949 Czechoslovakian Grand Prix with it at Brno, beating the works cars. Went on to win Le Mans in 1951 with Peter Walker in a Jaguar C-Type. Killed in 1958 when the car his half-brother was driving went off a bridge on the Tour de France.
